_what: How a record write says the road it came by (src/write-via.mjs): every list write's actor carries `via` { app, road, basis } beside `by` (who), kept once per change in the log's actor context, never per field. `roads` turn the sign-in's kind (the text before its first colon) into words; `bases` say how the app name is known; `said` is the line a person reads. A new road or basis is one row here.

said._who: A person's own store is written by them or by their AIs and apps under their sign-in, so a write names them as `who_default` unless its actor names a person (actor.person, a shared space's member).
